order.notes: Standard processing. Validate item availability, apply standard catalog pricing in UGX, and confirm quantities. Note VAT is 18% in Uganda.

delivery.notes: Offer standard delivery via Posta Uganda, DHL Uganda, or regional courier partners. Estimate 1-3 business days within Greater Kampala; 2-5 days upcountry. Suggest free delivery threshold at UGX 150,000+.

payment.notes: Accept MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, bank cards (Stanbic, Centenary, dfcu, Equity Bank Uganda), and cash on delivery (COD). Apply standard promo codes and loyalty points. All amounts in UGX.

dispatch.notes: Route from nearest warehouse (Kampala Central, Namanve, or Mbarara). Standard packaging. Batch with other orders where efficient. Use Posta Uganda or DHL Uganda for last-mile.

order.notes: Priority processing. Verify real-time stock levels. Flag items with limited availability. Reserve inventory immediately. Apply express surcharge in UGX.

delivery.notes: Offer same-day (Kampala metro only) or next-day delivery via DHL Express Uganda, SafeBoda, or Glovo. Validate district/division for same-day eligibility. Check rider cutoff times (3 PM for same-day).

payment.notes: Prioritize instant payment: MTN MoMo push, Airtel Money, or bank cards. Apply express surcharge. Enhanced fraud screening for orders above UGX 2,000,000.

dispatch.notes: Route to warehouse closest to delivery district. Priority picking and packing. Use dedicated SafeBoda or Glovo courier for same-day Kampala drops. Confirm rider assignment before dispatch.

order.notes: Validate recurring item availability. Check subscription tier benefits. Apply subscriber discounts (10-20% off). Manage item substitution preferences for seasonal Ugandan products.

delivery.notes: Use preferred delivery schedule (weekly/bi-weekly/monthly). Optimize for customer's district/division. Coordinate with Posta Uganda or regional courier scheduled routes. Bundle with other subscription items.

payment.notes: Use stored MTN MoMo standing order, Airtel Money, or saved card. Apply subscriber discounts. Handle failed mobile money payment with automatic retry (2 attempts). Pro-rate partial subscription periods. All amounts in UGX.

dispatch.notes: Pre-pick subscription items 2 days ahead of ship date. Coordinate with scheduled delivery route. Use subscription-specific packaging with branding. Include loyalty reward inserts for Ugandan subscribers.
